height_storage: Reconstruct from input native tool + saved solved column state; no duplicated height file.
roughness_closure: Assumed effective microfacet closure: fourth root of baseline_roughness^4 plus isotropic unresolved retained-height slope variance. Gaussian spectral separation sigma=4 native texels (~78um), local variance sigma=4. No random fields. Not an optical prediction.
temperature_skin_role: Depth-resolved temperature sets Arrhenius dashpot viscosity; contact sets heat transfer, which changes retained displacement. That final displacement drives both geometry and roughness. skin_fraction is diagnostic only.
preserved: Source r1/r2 geometry/maps/scenes, palette, studio, cameras
